def.era.medieval.name: Middle Ages
def.era.medieval.desc: Villages of wood and stone, tilled fields and dirt roads.
def.material.soil.name: soil
def.material.soil.desc: Soft ground that is easy to dig.
def.material.granite.name: granite
def.material.granite.desc: Very hard, tough rock, slow to dig.
def.material.limestone.name: limestone
def.material.limestone.desc: Pale, soft rock, good for building.
def.material.sandstone.name: sandstone
def.material.sandstone.desc: Compacted sand rock, easy to work.
def.plant.oak.name: {count, plural, one {oak} other {oaks}}
def.plant.oak.desc: A sturdy tree of hard wood.
def.plant.pine.name: {count, plural, one {pine} other {pines}}
def.plant.pine.desc: A tall softwood tree that grows on the slopes.
def.plant.berry_bush.name: {count, plural, one {berry bush} other {berry bushes}}
def.plant.berry_bush.desc: Bears edible berries; it fruits again a few days after picking.
def.item.log.name: {count, plural, one {log} other {logs}}
def.item.stone.name: {count, plural, one {stone} other {stones}}
def.item.stone.desc: Loose stone left over from digging rock.
def.item.berries.name: {count, plural, one {berry} other {berries}}
def.item.berries.desc: Wild fruit. Not very filling, but better than nothing.
def.item.provisions.name: {count, plural, one {ration of provisions} other {rations of provisions}}
def.item.provisions.desc: Hard bread, cheese and dried meat for the first days.
def.need.hunger.name: hunger
def.need.hunger.desc: Without food, a settler grows weak and eventually dies.
def.need.rest.name: rest
def.need.rest.desc: A tired settler sleeps wherever they can.
def.creature.human.name: {count, plural, one {human} other {humans}}
def.work_type.mining.name: mining
def.work_type.mining.desc: Digging out walls and opening stairs down.
def.work_type.woodcutting.name: woodcutting
def.work_type.gathering.name: gathering
def.work_type.gathering.desc: Gathering berries and other wild fruit.
def.item_category.wood.name: wood
def.item_category.wood.desc: Logs and what is made from them.
def.item_category.stone.name: stone
def.item_category.food.name: food
def.work_type.hauling.name: hauling
def.work_type.hauling.desc: Carrying loose items to the stockpiles.
def.work_type.childcare.name: childcare
def.work_type.childcare.desc: Feed the babies, who cannot eat on their own.
def.material.timber.name: timber
def.material.timber.desc: Hewn logs for walls, floors and doors.
def.material.masonry.name: masonry
def.material.masonry.desc: Stones laid one upon another, firm and lasting.
def.buildable.wall.name: wall
def.buildable.wall.desc: Blocks the way and gives shape to houses.
def.buildable.floor.name: floor
def.buildable.floor.desc: Footing where there was air, to cross or climb.
def.buildable.door.name: door
def.buildable.ramp.name: ramp
def.buildable.ramp.desc: A slope to climb one level beside a wall.
def.buildable.stairs.name: stairs
def.work_type.construction.name: construction
def.work_type.construction.desc: Bringing materials to blueprints, building and taking down.
def.buildable.bed.name: bed
def.buildable.bed.desc: A wooden bed: whoever sleeps in it rests faster.
def.buildable.table.name: table
def.buildable.table.desc: A wooden table for the house.
def.buildable.chair.name: chair
def.buildable.chest.name: chest
def.buildable.chest.desc: Holds one pile of items, like a stockpile cell.
def.buildable.cradle.name: cradle
def.buildable.cradle.desc: A bed for a baby, who sleeps better in it.
def.life_pace.normal.name: normal
def.life_pace.normal.desc: One game year is one year of life: few generations per game.
def.life_pace.fast.name: fast
def.life_pace.fast.desc: Four years of life pass in each game year: a long game sees grandchildren.
def.life_pace.very_fast.name: very fast
def.life_pace.very_fast.desc: Eight years of life pass in each game year: generations come and go.
def.life_stage.baby.name: baby
def.life_stage.baby.desc: Crawls, sleeps a lot and depends on the grown-ups.
def.life_stage.child.name: {gender, select, female {girl} other {boy}}
def.life_stage.child.desc: Plays and learns, but does not work.
def.life_stage.adolescent.name: teenager
def.life_stage.adolescent.desc: Helps with light work, like gathering and hauling.
def.life_stage.adult.name: {gender, select, female {woman} other {man}}
def.life_stage.elder.name: {gender, select, female {old woman} other {old man}}
def.life_stage.elder.desc: Does any work, but works and walks more slowly.
def.trait.sociability.name: sociability
def.trait.sociability.desc: The wish to be with others and to chat.
def.trait.kindness.name: kindness
def.trait.kindness.desc: Treating others well: comforting rather than arguing.
def.trait.diligence.name: diligence
def.trait.diligence.desc: The will to work: a lazy colonist works slower and sees to their needs first.
def.trait.curiosity.name: curiosity
def.trait.curiosity.desc: The wish to learn from others.
def.trait.intelligence.name: intelligence
def.trait.intelligence.desc: How easily one learns, at work or from others.
def.trait.patience.name: patience
def.trait.patience.desc: Staying calm with others and when things go wrong.
def.interaction.chat.name: chat
def.interaction.joke.name: joke
def.interaction.joke.desc: A joke; with an impatient listener it can go down badly.
def.interaction.teach.name: teach
def.interaction.teach.desc: The one who knows more of a work teaches the other.
def.interaction.argue.name: argue
def.interaction.argue.desc: An argument between two who do not get along.
def.interaction.comfort.name: comfort
def.interaction.flirt.name: flirt
def.interaction.flirt.desc: An attempt to win someone over.
def.interaction.play.name: play
def.thought.hungry.name: hungry
def.thought.starving.name: starving
def.thought.starving.desc: Cannot think of anything but food.
def.thought.tired.name: tired
def.thought.slept_in_bed.name: slept in my bed
def.thought.slept_on_floor.name: slept on the ground
def.thought.slept_on_floor.desc: Spent the night on the ground.
def.thought.chatted.name: had a chat
def.thought.laughed.name: had a laugh
def.thought.played.name: played
def.thought.comforted.name: was comforted
def.thought.comforted.desc: Someone stood by them in a bad moment.
def.thought.argued.name: had an argument
def.thought.argued.desc: An argument that left a bad taste.
def.thought.rebuffed.name: was rebuffed
def.thought.rebuffed.desc: Tried their luck, and it was not returned.
def.thought.learned.name: learned something
def.thought.learned.desc: Went up a level in a skill.
def.thought.new_partner.name: found a partner
def.thought.new_partner.desc: Started a life as a couple.
def.thought.breakup.name: we broke up
def.thought.death_partner.name: my partner died
def.thought.death_child.name: lost a child
def.thought.death_child.desc: Lost a son or a daughter.
def.thought.death_parent.name: lost a parent
def.thought.death_friend.name: lost a friend
def.thought.death_colonist.name: someone in the village died
def.thought.desire_fulfilled.name: a wish came true
def.thought.desire_frustrated.name: a wish fell through
def.thought.desire_frustrated.desc: Did not get something they wanted.
def.thought.child_born.name: my baby was born
def.thought.child_born.desc: Had a son or a daughter.
def.crisis.refuse_work.name: refusing to work
def.crisis.refuse_work.desc: Only sees to their needs and wanders.
def.crisis.isolate.name: isolating
def.crisis.isolate.desc: Talks to nobody and keeps away from the others.
def.desire.learn_from.name: learn from someone
def.desire.learn_from.desc: Wants to learn more from the one who taught them.
def.desire.befriend.name: make a friend
def.desire.befriend.desc: Wants to befriend someone they like.
def.desire.find_partner.name: find a partner
def.desire.find_partner.desc: Wants to share their life with someone.
def.desire.own_bed.name: a bed of my own
def.desire.own_bed.desc: Is tired of sleeping on the ground.
def.desire.reconcile.name: make up
def.desire.reconcile.desc: Wants to make peace after an argument.
def.desire.have_child.name: have a child
def.desire.have_child.desc: Wants a son or a daughter with their partner.
def.thought.death_sibling.name: lost a sibling
def.thought.death_sibling.desc: A brother or a sister died.
def.item_category.grain.name: grain
def.item_category.refined.name: worked materials
def.item_category.refined.desc: Planks, handles, stone blocks and ingots.
def.item_category.ore.name: ore and fuel
def.item_category.tool.name: tools
def.item.cabbage.name: {count, plural, one {cabbage} other {cabbages}}
def.item.cabbage.desc: Garden vegetable. It keeps for about a month.
def.item.peas.name: {count, plural, one {pea} other {peas}}
def.item.peas.desc: A legume that keeps for months once dried.
def.item.bread.name: {count, plural, one {loaf of bread} other {loaves of bread}}
def.item.bread.desc: Baked bread. More filling than raw grain, but it goes hard soon.
def.item.pottage.name: {count, plural, one {pottage} other {pottages}}
def.item.pottage.desc: A hot vegetable stew. It spoils within a few days.
def.item.pickled_cabbage.name: {count, plural, one {pickled cabbage} other {pickled cabbages}}
def.item.pickled_cabbage.desc: Preserved cabbage: less filling, but it lasts a long time.
def.item.wheat.name: {count, plural, one {wheat} other {wheat}}
def.item.wheat.desc: Grain that keeps all winter and is ground into flour.
def.item.flour.name: {count, plural, one {flour} other {flour}}
def.item.flour.desc: Ground grain, ready for baking bread.
def.item.plank.name: {count, plural, one {plank} other {planks}}
def.item.plank.desc: A thick board sawn from a log.
def.item.handle.name: {count, plural, one {handle} other {handles}}
def.item.stone_block.name: {count, plural, one {stone block} other {stone blocks}}
def.item.stone_block.desc: Cut stone for building with ashlar.
def.item.iron_ingot.name: {count, plural, one {iron ingot} other {iron ingots}}
def.item.iron_ingot.desc: Smelted iron, ready to be forged.
def.item.iron_ore.name: {count, plural, one {iron ore} other {iron ore}}
def.item.iron_ore.desc: Rock rich in iron, smelted in a bloomery.
def.item.charcoal.name: {count, plural, one {charcoal} other {charcoal}}
def.item.charcoal.desc: Wood burned without air: the fuel for smelting.
def.item.iron_axe.name: {count, plural, one {iron axe} other {iron axes}}
def.item.iron_axe.desc: Fells trees faster than bare hands. Each colonist carries one.
def.item.iron_pickaxe.name: {count, plural, one {iron pickaxe} other {iron pickaxes}}
def.item.iron_pickaxe.desc: Digs faster than bare hands. Each colonist carries one.
def.item.iron_hoe.name: {count, plural, one {iron hoe} other {iron hoes}}
def.item.iron_hoe.desc: Works the fields faster. Each colonist carries one.
def.item.iron_hammer.name: {count, plural, one {iron hammer} other {iron hammers}}
def.item.iron_hammer.desc: Builds faster. Each colonist carries one.
def.quality.poor.name: poor
def.quality.poor.desc: Made with little skill: worth less and does less.
def.quality.normal.name: normal
def.quality.normal.desc: The usual result of a trade.
def.quality.good.name: good
def.quality.good.desc: Well made: worth more and does more.
def.quality.excellent.name: excellent
def.quality.excellent.desc: The work of a master of the trade.
def.quality.masterwork.name: masterwork
def.quality.masterwork.desc: A piece to be remembered: only the most skilled make one.

def.work_type.carpentry.desc: Sawing planks, carving handles and making furniture at the carpentry bench.
def.work_type.stonecutting.name: stonecutting

def.work_type.cooking.name: cooking
def.work_type.cooking.desc: Grinding flour, baking bread and cooking meals.
def.work_type.farming.name: farming
def.work_type.farming.desc: Sowing and reaping in the farm zones.
def.work_type.research.name: research
def.work_type.research.desc: Studying in the scriptorium to discover knowledge.
def.work_type.smelting.name: smelting
def.work_type.smithing.name: smithing
def.work_type.smithing.desc: Forging iron tools at the forge.
def.material.planks.name: planks
def.material.planks.desc: Sawn boards for walls, floors, doors and furniture.
def.material.ashlar.name: ashlar
def.material.ashlar.desc: Cut stone blocks for walls and floors.
def.buildable.carpenter_bench.name: carpenter's bench
def.buildable.carpenter_bench.desc: A bench with tools to saw planks and carve handles.
def.buildable.mason_bench.name: mason's bench
def.buildable.mason_bench.desc: A bench with chisels to cut stone into blocks.
def.buildable.kitchen.name: kitchen
def.buildable.kitchen.desc: A hearth with a pot to grind, bake and cook.
def.recipe.plank.name: Saw planks
def.recipe.handle.name: Carve handles
def.recipe.handle.desc: One plank makes two tool handles.
def.recipe.stone_block.name: Cut blocks
def.recipe.stone_block.desc: One stone is cut into a stone block.
def.recipe.flour.name: Grind flour
def.recipe.flour.desc: Two wheat are ground by hand into two flour.
def.recipe.bread.name: Bake bread
def.recipe.bread.desc: Two flour make three loaves of bread.
def.recipe.pottage.name: Cook pottage
def.recipe.pottage.desc: Cabbage and peas are stewed into a pottage that feeds more.
def.recipe.pickled_cabbage.name: Pickle cabbage
def.recipe.pickled_cabbage.desc: Pickled cabbage lasts much longer than fresh.

def.knowledge.carpentry.desc: Saw planks, carve handles and build the carpenter's bench.
def.knowledge.cooking.name: Cooking
def.knowledge.cooking.desc: Build the kitchen and cook pottage.
def.knowledge.stonecutting.name: Stonecutting
def.knowledge.stonecutting.desc: Cut stone blocks and build the mason's bench.

def.knowledge.joinery.desc: Fine furniture of planks, like the long table.
def.knowledge.milling.name: Milling and baking
